text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, members of 
the Mejiro family gather to hold a 
strategy meeting on how to surpass Silence 
Suzuka in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the discussion, originating from 
Mejiro Bright, they arrived at the answer: 
the strength of the "Mejiro Family Bond" 
would be their ultimate weapon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Drawing upon their own strengths, the 
Mejiro umamusume train Mejiro Bright with 
both strictness and warmth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The history woven by the Mejiros—its hopes 
and dreams were passed down to Mejiro 
Bright.
